headline: I build web apps and the databases and reports behind them.
lede: I've spent 7+ years writing PHP, JavaScript, SQL and Java for business software. At Turn 14 Distribution I built PHP and MySQL apps for a B2B e-commerce platform and a warehouse management system. At Comcast I work on the daily reports and data pipelines business teams rely on, mostly making slow jobs fast and adding alerts for when one fails.
